# 🧩 Documentation Templates

Use these templates for future product and engineering work. Their presence does not imply that the corresponding process or system already exists.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Record a technical decision |
| [Architecture](architecture-template.md) | Document a system or module |
| [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md) | Define a proposed feature |
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Plan verification |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md) | Record an individual test |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Capture a reproducible defect |
| [Incident report](incident-report-template.md) | Record an operational incident |
| [Risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md) | Assess and track risks |
| [Security review](security-review-template.md) | Document security analysis |
| [Accessibility review](accessibility-review-template.md) | Review terminal accessibility |
| [Runbook](runbook-template.md) | Document an operational procedure |
| [User guide](user-guide-template.md) | Write task-oriented instructions |
| [Onboarding](onboarding-template.md) | Guide new contributors |
| [Documentation review](documentation-review-template.md) | Review docs and assets |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Verify a future release |

Every completed record should include owner, status, evidence, risks, verification, and review history where appropriate.
